topic: Geographic Perspectives: Global Change (Population Distribution, Global Climate, Global Resource Consumption)
subject: geography

items.q: What is the difference between weather and climate?
items.correct: Weather is day-to-day; climate is the long-term average (~30 years).
items.why: Weather is short-term conditions; climate is the typical pattern over decades.

items.q: Does climate change just mean everywhere gets hotter?
items.correct: No — it brings more extreme, varied weather (floods, droughts, storms).
items.misconception: Yes, it only means uniform warming everywhere.
items.random_wrong: It has no link to human activity.
items.why: Average warming shifts weather patterns, increasing extremes, not simply raising every temperature.
